newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA ENERGY WORKERS OPPOSE PRIVATISATION.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA ENERGY WORKERS OPPOSE PRIVATISATION.

text.p: Thousands of Romanian workers in the energy sector protested on Thursday against privatisation plans by the government.
"Don't destroy the power grid!" read banners carried by some 4,000 members of the Univers trade union who staged a peaceful rally in central Bucharest.
Trade union leaders said they opposed plans by the government to split the Renel RA electricity authority into smaller companies and eventually to privatise them.
Complete sell-off of Renel could lead to higher energy prices and low investments in the sector, they said.

The new centrist coalition cabinet of Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea last month launched a package of tough reforms to put Romania's economy on market footing. Privatisation of state industries are priorities of the package.
"We are not against Renel's privatisation but we want the state to maintain a controlling stake in it," union leader Adrian Iordache said.
The Univers trade union, groups some 45,000 members who are employed by Renel in its transport, maintenance and distribution sectors.
Renel employs a total of 93,000 workers. REUTER
